text: Johnson Medical Centre receives 100% of broker Eric Maynard's referrals - a small book of 7 claims worth $34,540 - while $3,247 of clinic money reaches the broker through seven separate shell-account paths, and the broker holds an undisclosed 17.1% stake in the clinic. The amounts are modest, which caps severity, but the structure is complete: total dependence, hidden ownership, and layered payments that match expected commission almost exactly, as if routed to avoid a visible broker line. The honest alternative - a declared investment plus commission netting - fails on the word undisclosed. This pair also anchors two circular-payment alerts over the same conduits. Next step: obtain the stake documentation and unwind the seven shell paths end to end.
